pages.text: A little boat was tied up in the canal. Pongi climbed aboard with her little brother, who was holding a shell. Dad untied the rope.
Pongi held an oar in both paws. "I want to row today."
The oar was heavier than Pongi expected. Pongi tensed her shoulders.
Splash! The boat turned to the right.
Pongi rowed the other way. The boat turned to the left.
The boat spun round and round in one spot. A duck swam past.
Pongi's arms hurt. Dad sat at the bow without saying a word.
Pongi's little brother took the oar on the other side. He put the shell on his lap.
Splash, splash. The boat moved straight ahead.
"We did it!" Pongi's little brother had already let go of the oar and was looking at the shell.
